description: Stationnements vélos gares régionales is a dataset listed in data.centrevaldeloire.fr open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Région Centre-Val de Loire. Recensement et caractérisation des stationnements cyclables disponibles dans et autour des gares ferroviaires de la région Centre-Val de Loire. Coverage: Centre-Val de Loire. The portal files it under Mobilité. Its keywords are vélo, gare, stationnement. The portal shows 167 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-08-31 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-centrevaldeloire-fr-portal.
